target: RMUC2027 central tower, current synthetic map asset

delta_from_v2.D1_four_edge_truncation: target.truncated_edges {left,right,top,bottom} required; truncated = any edge; per-edge truncation_source; capture-vs-annotator conflict resolution (annotator wins) recorded in truncation_conflicts
delta_from_v2.D2_reference_pixel_criterion: geometry.green_pixels required for present frames; keypoint may only be non-null when green_pixels >= 3 AND visually confirmed; otherwise keypoint=null + UNAVAILABLE + REFERENCE_TOO_SMALL
delta_from_v2.D3_unverified_confusers: new confusers[] list with verified=false allowed together with negative_type=TARGET_ABSENT; SIMILAR_STRUCTURE/OTHER_LANDMARK require at least one verified confuser; unverified confusers must never be written as verified similar structures
delta_from_v2.D4_bbox_source: geometry.bbox_source enum records ANNOTATOR_VISUAL / ANNOTATOR_VISUAL_WITH_PROJECTION_AID / PROJECTION_AID_CALIBRATED
delta_from_v2.D6_dataset_role: annotation.dataset_role enum enables the pilot-34 -> development/annotation-calibration transfer without deleting files
delta_from_v2.D7_near_bottom_truncation_fact: the pilot found near-family frames whose base pedestal is cut by the bottom frame edge while the capture metadata only tracked left/right truncation; v2.1 requires all four edges and records the metadata conflict

source_policy.projection_aid: pose/geometry projection may be used only as a visual aid or a draft prior; it must be marked in geometry.bbox_source and never treated as unconditional truth
source_policy.visual_qa_required: a projection-derived or calibrated draft bbox must be visually checked for every frame; corrected frames must be marked and re-checked
source_policy.split_label: split is recorded per frame; a frame set already exposed for pilot/calibration must not be re-declared as sealed
source_policy.independent_annotation: human independent annotation with adjudication is the only path to certification-grade labels; agent proxy annotations stay disclosed

units_and_coordinates.bbox: xywh, source-image pixels, origin top-left, no normalization in source labels
units_and_coordinates.keypoint: source-image pixels (x, y) and boolean visible
units_and_coordinates.truncated_edges: booleans per image edge; a true edge means the target structure continues past that edge and is clipped
units_and_coordinates.model_export: normalization only in the exporter; letterbox scale/pad recorded

bbox_scope.rule: axis-aligned box of the visible target object itself = head/top light-rack plus tapering body (and, if present and attached, its stepped base pedestal); clipped at every image edge
includes: head and its two arms / top light rack
attached stepped base pedestal that is visually part of the tower
bbox_scope.truncation: bbox covers only the visible part; clip at every edge; never extrapolate; set the corresponding truncated_edges flags
bbox_scope.compatibility: NOT compatible with v1-era boxes that included the arena platform (median height difference 37 px, n=18); do not mix label conventions in one training/evaluation set

fields.source: {run, family, group_id, generation, sequence, split, origin_split_in_freeze}
fields.dataset_role: EXPLORATORY_EVAL | DEVELOPMENT | ANNOTATION_CALIBRATION | TRAIN | VALIDATION; records what the frame may be used for without deleting it
fields.target.undecidable: boolean; true only when presence itself cannot be settled
fields.target.truncated: boolean; derived from truncated_edges (any edge true)
fields.target.truncated_edges: {left, right, top, bottom} booleans; REQUIRED in v2.1
fields.target.truncation_source: per true edge: ANNOTATOR_VISUAL | CAPTURE_METADATA | BOTH
fields.target.truncation_conflicts: optional list [{edge, capture, annotator, resolution: ANNOTATOR_OVER_CAPTURE}] when capture metadata and visual annotation disagree
fields.target.occluded: boolean; hidden by another structure (frame-edge cutting is not occlusion)
fields.geometry.bbox_xywh: pixels; required for present targets except full OCCLUDED
fields.geometry.keypoint: {name, x, y, visible}; null when not visible
fields.geometry.green_pixels: integer green-cue pixel count used for the reference-availability decision; required for present frames
fields.confusers: list of visible structures that could confuse the detector but are not the verified target: {confuser_id, description, bbox_xywh|null, green_cue|null, verified, verification_source, verification_note, source}
fields.candidates: ambiguous target candidates only (v2 semantics, unchanged)
fields.annotator.independent_of_detector_cue: boolean; must be false when reference_source=COLOR_CUE_ASSISTED
fields.pixel_basis: {image_width, image_height, fx_px, cx_px, cy_px, projection_model, bearing_formula}

presence_states.geometry: bbox required; keypoint per reference rules
no bbox/keypoint; negative_type required; may carry unverified confusers
no bbox/keypoint; negative_type null; undecidable_reason required; excluded from positive and negative denominators as GT_UNOBSERVABLE

definitions.FULL: whole target visible, no frame-edge cut, no occlusion
definitions.PARTIAL: visible but frame-edge cut and/or partly hidden

truncated_edges_rule: each of left/right/top/bottom is true iff the target structure continues past that image edge and is clipped
bbox is clipped to the visible part; no extrapolation across a true edge
truncation_source is required for every true edge: ANNOTATOR_VISUAL when seen in the image, CAPTURE_METADATA when taken from acquisition metadata, BOTH when they agree
when capture metadata and visual annotation disagree the annotator wins; record the conflict in truncation_conflicts with resolution ANNOTATOR_OVER_CAPTURE
near-family fact: the bottom base pedestal can be clipped while acquisition metadata only tracked left/right; bottom edges must be checked visually
precedence: full occlusion -> visibility=OCCLUDED, occluded=true, keypoint=null, reference UNAVAILABLE/REFERENCE_OCCLUDED
partial by another object -> visibility=PARTIAL, occluded=true; truncation_edges as observed
frame-edge cut -> visibility=PARTIAL, truncated_edges set; occluded=false unless also hidden
both -> visibility=PARTIAL, occluded=true, truncated_edges set; record both
constraints: visibility FULL requires all truncated_edges false and occluded false
visibility PARTIAL requires truncated or occluded
occluded=true requires visibility PARTIAL or OCCLUDED

reference_rules.availability_criterion: keypoint may be non-null ONLY when geometry.green_pixels >= 3 AND the green light is visually confirmed at the annotated position; otherwise keypoint=null + reference_status=UNAVAILABLE + reference_unavailable_reason=REFERENCE_TOO_SMALL (or the specific reason)
reference_rules.green_pixels_recording: geometry.green_pixels records the strict green-cue pixel count used for the decision (rule: g>=90, g-r>=25, g-b>=25, largest 4-connected component)
reference_rules.provenance: reference_source=COLOR_CUE_ASSISTED requires annotator.independent_of_detector_cue=false; the anchor residual is then not independent evidence

confuser_rules.purpose: record structures that could be mistaken for the central tower without claiming they are verified similar structures
confuser_rules.fields: confuser_id, description, bbox_xywh|null, green_cue|null, verified (boolean), verification_source (null | WORLD_POSE_OR_MAP_DB | HUMAN_ADJUDICATION | EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE), verification_note, source (ANNOTATOR | COLOR_CUE)
confuser_rules.unverified: verified=false confusers are allowed together with negative_type=TARGET_ABSENT and must never be promoted to SIMILAR_STRUCTURE
confuser_rules.verified: verified=true requires a non-empty verification_source and verification_note
confuser_rules.negative_type_similar_structure: SIMILAR_STRUCTURE and OTHER_LANDMARK require at least one verified=true confuser
confuser_rules.no_invention: do not invent confusers; record only structures actually visible in the frame

ambiguity_rules.set_ambiguous: unresolved target identity or multiple equally plausible target candidates
ambiguity_rules.candidates: ambiguous target candidates only; required when ambiguous=true
ambiguity_rules.keypoint: never emit a guessed keypoint for an ambiguous frame
ambiguity_rules.training: ambiguous frames are excluded from positive training by default

annotator_provenance.disclosure: AGENT_PROXY is not expert or human independent review; a hash plus process record is only process isolation, not statistical independence
annotator_provenance.bulk_mode: BULK_CALIBRATED_WITH_FULL_VISUAL_QA must be used when bboxes were initialised from a calibrated projection prior and all frames were visually reviewed; frame-level corrections must be recorded

pixel_basis.rule: record actual image size and intrinsics; do not reuse intrinsics across resolutions
pixel_basis.bearing: image bearing = atan2(x_px - cx_px, fx_px); image angle, not world bearing or distance
pixel_basis.measured_scale: current 320x240 front RGB: fx=160, cx=160, cy=120, 1 px ~= 0.3581 deg; green light core 4-9 px wide (area 10-49 px) at 320x240

mapping_rules: present + keypoint non-null -> bbox + (kx, ky, v=1)
present + keypoint null (green_pixels < 3 or not visible) -> bbox + placeholder coordinate (bbox centre) + v=0; v=0 excluded from anchor/bearing/coverage denominators
present + full OCCLUDED with no bbox -> no positive label
absent -> empty label file, image listed explicitly in the manifest
undecidable -> no positive label; excluded from both positive and negative denominators
ambiguous -> no positive label by default
truncated_edges -> keep the clipped box; all edge flags go to the sidecar

denominator_rules.detection_fourfold: GT fully occluded or undecidable frames are excluded from TP/FP/FN/TN and counted separately as GT_UNOBSERVABLE
denominator_rules.gt_unobservable_vs_model_unknown: annotation-side GT_UNOBSERVABLE must never be merged with model-side UNKNOWN
denominator_rules.keypoint_anchor: anchor/bearing denominators include only present frames with keypoint non-null (v=1)
denominator_rules.keypoint_coverage: coverage denominator = present frames with reference_status=MANUAL_APPROX; green<3 frames are excluded and counted
denominator_rules.absent_negative: confirmed absent frames form the negative denominator; undecidable frames are not negatives
denominator_rules.ambiguous: ambiguous frames excluded from positive and negative denominators by default

required_checks: green_pixels recorded and keypoint non-null only when green_pixels >= 3
absent/undecidable has no geometry; undecidable has no negative_type
confusers validated; SIMILAR_STRUCTURE requires verified confuser

v2_to_v2_1_mapping.target.truncated: still present, now derived from truncated_edges
v2_to_v2_1_mapping.SIMILAR_STRUCTURE: now requires a verified confuser; unverified structures must use TARGET_ABSENT + confusers(verified=false)
